name: GVGAI-LLM
description: We introduce GVGAI-LLM, a video game benchmark for evaluating the reasoning and problem-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Built on the General Video Game AI framework, it features a diverse collection of arcade-style games designed to test a model's ability to handle tasks that differ from most existing LLM benchmarks. The benchmark leverages a video game description language that enables the rapid creation of new games (including rules and levels), helping to prevent overfitting over time.
